title: Beleaguered in Pekin: The Boxer's War Against the Foreigner

Coltman recounts his experience as a medical practitioner responding to injured individuals involved in the confrontation, showcasing the rising tensions marked by anti-foreign hostility. He presents the conflicting viewpoints of Chinese officials and foreign nationals, revealing the precarious political landscape that led to escalated violence and ultimately the siege.
